# Crown Media Group — VS Code Power Shortcuts

## Claude Code
- Ctrl+Shift+C → Open Claude Code panel
- Ctrl+K → Inline edit with Claude
- Alt+K → @-mention file in Claude prompt
- Ctrl+N → New Claude conversation

## Navigation
- Ctrl+P → Find any file instantly
- Ctrl+Shift+F → Search across all files
- Ctrl+` → Open terminal
- Ctrl+Shift+` → New terminal

## Git (GitLens)
- Ctrl+Shift+G → Source control panel
- Alt+B → Toggle git blame inline

## Live Server
- Alt+L Alt+O → Open with Live Server
- Alt+L Alt+C → Close Live Server

## Todo Tree
- Click TODO in tree → jumps to that line

## Power Moves
- Ctrl+Shift+P → Command palette (everything)
- Ctrl+Shift+X → Extensions panel
- Ctrl+, → Settings
